summary: Volkswagen Auto Lease/Loan Underwritten Funding, LLC filed a Form 8-K reporting an Underwriting Agreement dated September 15, 2026 with Mizuho Securities USA as representative of underwriters for Volkswagen Auto Lease Trust 2026-B. The trust will issue $991,830,000 in Class A-1, A-2-A, A-2-B, A-3 and A-4 auto-lease-backed notes at an undisclosed price, closing on or about September 22, 2026. Proceeds fund a transaction SUBI tied to VW and Audi retail leases. This is a routine ABS shelf takedown, not a special situation.
